subject: Post-call: budget-to-commit path & per-service token split
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sam Weller <sam.weller@brightlabs.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: token split & target $/1M

Hi Sam — thanks again for the intro call earlier today. Quick recap and two asks so we can size a realistic pilot quote and commit path: 

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Primary use case: multi-turn customer support + knowledge search (chat + embeddings) and a small automated reranking step for candidate answers.
- Expected ramp: POC month ~1: 500k tokens, month 2: 1.5M, month 3+: steady-state ~3.5M tokens/mo (estimate from engineering).
- Important constraints: sub-200ms p50 for chat autosuggests routing to lower-latency chat variants; embeddings must be near real-time for search (300ms target).

Asks (helps us quote):
1) Confirm a realistic steady-state monthly token target youd be comfortable committing to for a pilot-to-paid transition (range is fine).
2) Confirm rough split across function types: chat (multi-turn generation), embeddings (search/indexing calls), reranking (candidate scoring). We proposed a default split below — can you validate/adjust?

Our proposed steady-state split (please confirm):
- Chat (generation + context tokens): 70% (~2.45M tokens/mo at 3.5M total)
- Embeddings (upserts + inference): 20% (~0.7M tokens/mo equivalent)
- Rerank (short candidates, high QPS bursts): 10% (~0.35M tokens/mo)

Pricing targets & path to commit
- For sizing the pilot quote, what is your target blended price per 1M tokens that makes a multi-month commitment attractive? Example ranges we typically see for similar workloads: $400-$1,200 / 1M, depending on model mix and reserved capacity.
- If you can give a target $/1M or a budget band ($/mo) well produce a committed pricing proposal and a mutual action plan.

Attachments: Im including a draft mutual action plan and a pricing sheet stub.

Next steps: if you confirm numbers, Ill circulate a pilot quote and a 30-day mutual action plan for signoff.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

[attachment: BrightLabs_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx] [attachment: pricing_sheet_v2.pdf]

From: Sam Weller <sam.weller@brightlabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Nathan Li <nathan.li@brightlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: token split & target $/1M

Monica — thanks, that recap is spot on. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The steady-state estimate is in the right ballpark; our conservative planning target is 3M tokens/mo (we'd like pilot to show performance at 3.5M)
- On split: I agree with the general proportions but want to adjust embeddings up a bit because our semantic search will be used by more internal tooling than I initially indicated. New proposed split: Chat 60% / Embeddings 30% / Rerank 10%.
- Target blended price: Ideally wed be in the $600-$800 / 1M tokens range for a pilot that leads to a committed monthly reservation. If theres a clear path to $500 / 1M at a 12-month reserved commit, thatd be compelling.

Can you produce a two-tiered quote: 
A) Pilot (1–2 months) — capacity to handle spikes to 4M tokens/mo, month-to-month pricing (no long commit).
B) Reserved commit (6–12 months) — show breakpoints at 3M and 5M committed monthly tokens and the blended $/1M at each tier.

Also, well need model-level guidance. For example: which chat model would you recommend for sub-200ms p50 versus a higher-quality slower variant? And what embedding model/options for low-latency search vs cost?

Thanks — Sam
Sam Weller
Head of Product, BrightLabs
sam.weller@brightlabs.com
[phone omitted]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sam Weller <sam.weller@brightlabs.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: token split & target $/1M

Sam — great, appreciate the quick clarification. Below is a concrete pilot proposal we can send to procurement that maps your asks to model choices, per-model volume split, and a two-tier pricing table.

Assumptions (pilot steady-state = 3.0M tokens/mo; spike capacity = 4.0M)
- Revised split (your ask): Chat 60% (1.8M), Embeddings 30% (0.9M), Rerank 10% (0.3M).
- Traffic shape: chat average context length ~1.2k tokens/session, embeddings calls are short but frequent (average 64-token input), rerank uses short candidates (avg 40 tokens) but higher QPS at peak.

Model recommendations (for pricing ballpark and perf):
- Chat (low-latency): rw-chat-3b-q4f (low-cost, optimized for latency) — target p50 < 200ms with continuous batching and small KV cache.
- Chat (higher-quality fallback): rw-chat-13b-fp16 (higher cost for complex reasoning; used for selected flows).
- Embeddings (search): rw-embed-2b-quant (balanced latency/cost), with option to upsert smaller vector sizes for cold-start cost savings.
- Rerank: rw-rank-1b-fast (short candidate scoring; pay per call, low token length).

Two-tier quote (blended examples only; final numbers in attached pricing sheet)
- Pilot (month-to-month, supports up to 4M tokens spike): blended $/1M = $900 -> pilot monthly ~$2,700 at 3M baseline.
- Reserved commit (6–12 months):
  * Commit 3M/mo -> blended $/1M = $700 -> $2,100/mo
  * Commit 5M/mo -> blended $/1M = $550 -> $2,750/mo

Reserve mechanics and incentives
- 6-month minimum commit gets 10% off the listed reserved rates; 12-month gives 18% off.
- We can include 30% pilot credits against first reserved invoice if you sign within 60 days of pilot completion.

Next steps Ill take:
- Send a formal two-sheet (pilot vs reserved) that shows per-model estimated token distribution, per-model effective $/1M (based on model weight), and a simple sensitivity table for monthly costs at 2M/3M/5M.
- Update mutual action plan with procurement milestones and a proposed pilot start date of Feb 8 (if that works for your team).

Anything to add or change before I generate the formal quote?

Best,
Monica
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

[attachment: pricing_sheet_v2.pdf]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: BrightLabs — pilot pricing math & approval request

Team — forwarding Sam's confirmation on splits and target ranges. Quick internal note and ask: 

Summary:
- Account: BrightLabs (BL-3921)
- Confirmed steady-state target for pilot sizing: 3.0M tokens/mo (want spike capacity to 4.0M)
- Confirmed split: Chat 60% / Embeddings 30% / Rerank 10%
- Customer target blended price: $600-$800 / 1M with aspiration to get to $500 / 1M on 12-month reserve

Proposal I plan to send:
- Pilot (month-to-month): blended $900/1M (allows margin for spiky traffic & higher-quality fallback usage)
- Reserve (3M commit): blended $700/1M; Reserve (5M commit): blended $550/1M
- 12-month lock can reach sub-$500 only if they commit to a higher proportion of cheaper chat variants and accept fewer fallback 13b calls.

Ask: please review the attached pricing sheet and confirm any upper/lower bounds youd want me to avoid (e.g., do we want to offer $650/1M as a mid-point for 6-month commit?) Also flag if legal needs to be looped earlier because of the 12-month deep discount.

Thanks — Monica
